sentences.en: There was a flare-up between local residents and state regulators.
sentences.zh: 当地居民与州监管机构之间发生了冲突。

sentences.en: The case was referred to the media regulator.
sentences.zh: 该案件被提交给了媒体监管机构。

sentences.en: The new air quality regulator will help reduce pollution in our city.
sentences.zh: 新的空气质量调节器将有助于减少我们城市的污染。
